diary.subject: Chemistry (5070)
diary.title: Organic Chemistry: Hydrocarbons & Fractional Distillation
diary.content: Review Chapter 14: Fractional Distillation of Crude Oil. Solve Past Paper Worksheets questions 1 to 14. CamScanner scanned lecture planner and lab observation table attached below.
diary.homework: Complete Workbook Exercise 14.2 on page 112. Memorize structural formulas of Alkanes & Alkenes.

diary.subject: Mathematics Syllabus D (4024)
diary.title: Trigonometry & 3D Vectors Practice
diary.content: Past Papers Oct/Nov 2024 Paper 2 questions on Sine rule, Cosine rule and Angle of Elevation. Step-by-step working required on loose ledger sheets.

diary.subject: English Language (1123)
diary.title: Directed Writing: Speech on Digital Literacy & Artificial Intelligence
diary.content: Draft a 250-word formal speech for the morning assembly highlighting benefits and pitfalls of AI in student learning. Use persuasive techniques.
diary.homework: Submit clean draft in assignment folder by Thursday 8:00 AM.

diary.subject: Urdu (3248)
diary.title: Ghazaliyat Tashreeh: Allama Iqbal (Bang-e-Dara)
diary.content: Allama Iqbal ki ghazal 'Sitaron se aagay jahan aur bhi hain' ke pehle 4 ashaar ki tashreeh aur hawala-e-kalam khushkhat tehreer karein.
diary.homework: Urdu notebook page 45 par sawalat 1 ta 5 mukammal karein.

diary.subject: Physics (Matric Board)
diary.title: Kinematics & Newton Laws of Motion Numericals
diary.content: Solve Board Questions on Equations of Uniformly Accelerated Motion (v = u + at, s = ut + 0.5at^2). CamScanner work planner page is uploaded.
diary.homework: Numericals 2.1 to 2.7 from Punjab Textbook Board Physics Class 9.

diary.subject: Biology (Matric Board)
diary.title: Cell Biology & Electron Microscope Diagrams
diary.content: Draw neat labeled diagram of Plant and Animal Cell highlighting Mitochondria, Golgi Apparatus & Nucleus with HB pencil.
diary.homework: Memorize differences between Prokaryotes and Eukaryotes for surprise quiz tomorrow.

diary.subject: General Science
diary.title: Periodic Table & Chemical Bonding
diary.content: Study first 20 elements of the periodic table with chemical symbols, atomic numbers, and mass numbers.
diary.homework: Draw electron configuration diagrams for Carbon, Oxygen, and Sodium.

diary.subject: Mathematics
diary.title: Fractions & Long Division Practice
diary.content: Solve Exercise 3.4: Addition and Subtraction of unlike fractions with LCM method.
diary.homework: Page 58 questions 1 to 10 in Math notebook.
